answer: A second name must cost more than the first. An applicant must forge a commit-reveal work receipt against the epoch seed and lock a quadratic stake: the nth key from one funding cluster posts n-squared times the median wage, revealed only after the beacon rotates. Four seated signers, one from each lotus-graph component cut by autonomous system and funder, must countersign. Reused seeds, shared clusters, or overlapping signers slash the stake and collapse those keys to one seat. Residual bond follows a comet decay across two later panels, so cloned names bleed capital instead of buying votes.
